project.name: el_nino
project.description: El Nino is the Layer-3 autonomous paper-trading engine: it consumes deterministic Layer-2 market-state snapshots, derives features, classifies the market regime, builds a paper-only gold decision packet, admits it through a runtime guard block, and simulates execution against a paper portfolio. A Risk Control guardrail engine validates proposed trades against hard limits, a Supervisor Office decision engine selects capability upgrades under treasury constraints, and a JARVIS graph-intelligence front end exposes the project's engineering dev_graph via a read-only FastAPI/Neo4j bridge with a GraphRAG console and voice I/O.

nodes.name: Trading Decision Pipeline (Layer-3 Analysis)
nodes.summary: The deterministic, snapshot-local analysis chain that turns one Layer-2 truth snapshot into a paper-only gold decision packet. It enforces a fail-closed consumption gate, derives a feature vector, selects a market regime via a rule table, and builds a cited, paper-only decision. Same snapshot plus same versions always yields a byte-identical packet.

businessRules: Layer-3 MUST NOT read raw observations; it only consumes latest_snapshot.json or queries by snapshot_id
Fail-closed: a non-consumable snapshot (quality gate failed / absent) produces no output
Deterministic: same snapshot + same schema/policy versions => bit-identical packet
Packets are always paper_only planning artifacts, never live orders (ADR-006)
Cited features are read verbatim from the feature vector, never invented
crossDomainInteractions: Emits the GoldDecisionPacket consumed by the Paper-Trading Runtime & Execution domain
Forwards snapshot guard flags so downstream runtime guards can echo provenance

nodes.name: Paper-Trading Runtime & Execution
nodes.summary: Wraps a pure gold decision packet in stateful, append-only runtime admission, then simulates execution against a paper portfolio. The runtime evaluates a six-guard block and emits an ADMIT / HOLD / REJECT verdict plus a ledger entry; execution fills only an approved LONG on a fresh snapshot, marking the portfolio. Everything is paper_only and never mutates the upstream packet.

businessRules: Runtime wraps the GoldDecisionPacket by reference and never mutates or re-emits it (ADR-009)
Verdict is fail-closed: WATCH packet HOLDs, first failing required guard REJECTs, else ADMIT
Idempotent on source_snapshot_id (once-ever execution discipline)
Each evaluation appends exactly one self-describing ledger entry; no hidden clock or state
Only an approved LONG on a fresh snapshot fills; everything else yields a no-fill record
crossDomainInteractions: Consumes the GoldDecisionPacket produced by the Trading Decision Pipeline domain
Receives a forwarded GuardResult from the Risk Control domain (never recomputes it at execution)

nodes.name: Risk Control (Guardrail Engine)
nodes.summary: The trade-validation boundary that enforces hard-limit predicates as a short-circuit conjunction. Given a TradeValidationRequest it evaluates position size, daily-loss cap, max trades, max positions, and withdrawal-disabled checks, returning an approve/block decision that names the first failing predicate. Stateless, synchronous, deterministic, and fail-closed.

businessRules: ALL hard-limit predicates must pass to approve a trade (short-circuit conjunction)
Config is loaded fail-closed from the environment (hard limits)
Withdrawal must be disabled for any trade to be approved
Identical inputs always yield an identical decision (deterministic, stateless)
crossDomainInteractions: Produces the GuardResult forwarded into the Paper-Trading Runtime & Execution domain's execution gate (GATE-001)

nodes.name: Supervisor Office (Upgrade Decisions)
nodes.summary: The capability-evolution decision engine that scores candidate upgrades for the trading office under treasury constraints and institutional memory. Given a performance scorecard it either declares the office promotable (no upgrade needed) or ranks affordable, non-excluded upgrade options and selects one, emitting a deterministic decision packet with the resulting treasury state.

businessRules: Office is promotable (no upgrade) when realized PnL exceeds threshold and calibration is met
Options over the available treasury budget are ranked but not affordable
Options in institutional memory's exclusion set are ranked but never selected
Identical scorecard + catalog + treasury => identical decision packet (deterministic)
crossDomainInteractions: Evaluates performance derived from runtime/execution outcomes of the Paper-Trading Runtime domain

nodes.name: JARVIS Graph Intelligence
nodes.summary: The operator-facing front end and read-only graph bridge over the project's engineering dev_graph in Neo4j. A FastAPI service exposes node lookup, neighbor expansion, search, shortest path, and seed subgraphs, plus a GraphRAG ask endpoint and local Whisper/Piper voice I/O. The React HUD renders the graph, an answer console, and live pipeline/connector status.

businessRules: Every Neo4j query is READ-ONLY and parameterized; a keyword guard blocks mutating Cypher
GraphRAG answers are grounded ONLY in a retrieved dev_graph subgraph, cited and evidence-annotated
Ask returns 503 when no Claude key is configured; the UI falls back to the offline pure router
Voice STT/TTS return 503 when local Whisper/Piper is unavailable (Web Speech fallback)
crossDomainInteractions: Visualizes the Trading Decision Pipeline and Paper-Trading Runtime stages as live pipeline status
Reads the dev_graph that documents all other domains' modules, schemas, and decisions

nodes.name: Consume and Analyze Snapshot
nodes.summary: The end-to-end Layer-3 analysis chain: consume a Layer-2 snapshot through the fail-closed gate, build a feature vector, classify the market regime, and build a paper-only gold decision packet.

nodes.name: Admit Gold Decision
nodes.summary: Evaluate a gold decision packet against append-only runtime state: compute the six-guard block, resolve a fail-closed ADMIT/HOLD/REJECT verdict, append a ledger entry, and emit a runtime decision record.

nodes.name: Simulate Execution
nodes.summary: Act on an ADMIT record: confirm the verdict, apply the forwarded guard result, simulate a fill via the broker adapter for an approved LONG on a fresh snapshot, fold it into the portfolio, and emit an execution record.

nodes.name: Validate Trade
nodes.summary: Evaluate a proposed trade against hard-limit guardrail predicates as a short-circuit conjunction, returning an approve/block decision that names the first failing predicate.

nodes.name: Select Capability Upgrade
nodes.summary: Decide whether the trading office needs an upgrade: short-circuit when promotable, otherwise score each catalog option, apply budget and institutional-memory exclusions, and emit a decision packet with the resulting treasury state.

nodes.name: Query Dev Graph
nodes.summary: Serve read-only graph traversal over the dev_graph in Neo4j: report health, search or look up nodes, expand neighbors to a bounded depth, and return seed subgraphs for the HUD.

nodes.name: GraphRAG Ask
nodes.summary: Answer an operator question grounded only in a retrieved dev_graph subgraph: route the question, retrieve the relevant subgraph, ground and cite the answer (Claude uplink or offline pure router), and return a cited, evidence-annotated answer.

nodes.name: Voice Interaction
nodes.summary: Provide local voice I/O for the HUD: report voice-subsystem health, transcribe uploaded audio via Whisper (STT), and synthesize speech via Piper (TTS), each failing closed with 503 when the local model is unavailable.

nodes.name: Load Snapshot
nodes.summary: Load and parse latest_snapshot.json into a Snapshot model; an absent file is a legitimate 'no snapshot yet' (None), while a malformed payload raises a loud SnapshotContractError.

nodes.name: Apply Consumption Gate
nodes.summary: Fail-closed gate: a snapshot is consumable only if its Layer-2 quality gate passed; consume() returns the snapshot only when it is safe to act on, otherwise None so downstream stages output nothing.

nodes.name: Build Feature Vector
nodes.summary: Derive a frozen, snapshot-local FeatureVector from the consumed snapshot, with each feature carrying provenance (input series ids, max staleness, revision risk).

nodes.name: Classify Market Regime
nodes.summary: Run the rule-selection classifier over the feature vector to produce a RegimeClassification: the primary output is matched_rule_id and the regime is a pure projection of the matched rule.

nodes.name: Build Gold Decision Packet
nodes.summary: Combine the feature vector and regime classification into a deterministic, paper-only GoldDecisionPacket with a chosen direction, trust-score confidence, cited drivers, and a templated rationale.

nodes.name: Evaluate Six-Guard Block
nodes.summary: Compute every runtime guard (duplicate_ok, operational_ok, data_ok, freshness_ok, cooldown_ok, supervisor_ok stub) in canonical order to form the full audit block.

nodes.name: Resolve Fail-Closed Verdict
nodes.summary: Determine ADMIT/HOLD/REJECT: a WATCH packet HOLDs (no actionable stance), the first failing required guard REJECTs naming the guard, and otherwise the packet is ADMITted.

nodes.name: Append Ledger Entry
nodes.summary: Append exactly one self-describing LedgerEntry carrying this evaluation's inputs (snapshot id, packet id, verdict, triggered guard, digests, sequence) to the append-only runtime ledger.

nodes.name: Emit Runtime Decision Record
nodes.summary: Build the RuntimeDecisionRecord with a per-evaluation record_id binding the prior ledger state, the verdict, the full guard outcomes, ledger-state hashes, and the non-execution notice.

nodes.name: Check ADMIT Precondition
nodes.summary: Total, fail-closed entry: a non-ADMIT input is a caller error; an already-executed snapshot, a non-LONG stance, or a blocked guard short-circuits to a no-fill record (portfolio unchanged).

nodes.name: Apply Forwarded Guard Result
nodes.summary: Use the forwarded GATE-001 GuardResult (from the Guardrail Engine) as the execution gate; the outcome is never recomputed in the execution layer (no src/risk import).

nodes.name: Simulate Broker Fill
nodes.summary: For an approved LONG on a fresh snapshot, derive the fill via the SimulatedBrokerAdapter and fill model at the instrument price re-derived from the source snapshot.

nodes.name: Update Paper Portfolio
nodes.summary: Fold the buy into the position, recompute average cost and unrealized PnL marked at the mark price, and return a new, self-describing PortfolioState (state is an explicit value).

nodes.name: Emit Execution Record
nodes.summary: Produce the ExecutionRecord (with execution id and the appended ExecutionEntry) plus the new PortfolioState, always paper_only and wrapping the ADMIT record by reference.

nodes.name: Load Hard-Limit Config
nodes.summary: Load the fail-closed GuardrailConfig of hard limits from the environment; capturing it makes validation environment-independent and replay-deterministic.

nodes.name: Validate Request Shape
nodes.summary: Reject a malformed TradeValidationRequest before predicate evaluation so contract violations are caught loudly rather than approved by accident.

nodes.name: Evaluate Hard-Limit Predicates
nodes.summary: Run each pure predicate (position size, daily-loss cap, max trades, max positions, withdrawal disabled) as (request, config) -> (passed, reason).

nodes.name: Short-Circuit on First Failure
nodes.summary: Evaluate predicates as a short-circuit conjunction: ALL must pass to approve; the first failing predicate stops evaluation and is named in the decision.

nodes.name: Emit Validation Decision
nodes.summary: Return a deterministic TradeValidationDecision (approve or block) carrying the verdict and, on block, the first failing predicate's reason.

nodes.name: Check Promotable Short-Circuit
nodes.summary: Early exit: if realized PnL exceeds the promotable threshold and calibration is met, return a packet with no selected upgrade ('office is promotable — no upgrade needed').

nodes.name: Score Upgrade Options
nodes.summary: Score every candidate upgrade in the catalog against the evaluation scorecard using the deterministic scoring function.

nodes.name: Apply Budget and Exclusions
nodes.summary: Filter scored options: mark those excluded by institutional memory and those over the available treasury budget as unselectable, ranking the rest.

nodes.name: Emit Decision Packet
nodes.summary: Select the best affordable, non-excluded option and emit a DecisionPacket with the ranked options, rationale, and the resulting treasury state.

nodes.name: Check Bridge Health
nodes.summary: Report liveness, Neo4j connectivity, and graph size; the front-end connector chip flips to LIVE when this returns ok && neo4j.

nodes.name: Search or Look Up Node
nodes.summary: Resolve a node by canonical_id or run a label/text search over the dev_graph, returning the matching nodes' property bags.

nodes.name: Expand Neighbors
nodes.summary: Traverse outbound/inbound/both edges from a node to a bounded depth (1-3) to assemble its local neighborhood for the HUD.

nodes.name: Return Seed Subgraph
nodes.summary: Return a seed subgraph (by label or whole graph, bounded by limit) or a shortest path between two canonical_ids for graph rendering.

nodes.name: Route Question
nodes.summary: Match the operator's question to the most relevant dev_graph node via the pure, unit-tested question-to-answer router (the offline projection / Stage-3 gate).

nodes.name: Retrieve Grounding Subgraph
nodes.summary: Retrieve the dev_graph subgraph that grounds the answer; the live bridge layers a multi-hop neighborhood on top of the pure router's projection.

nodes.name: Ground and Cite Answer
nodes.summary: Explain the question grounded ONLY in the retrieved subgraph via the Claude uplink, or fall back to the offline pure router; the answer is cited and evidence-annotated.

nodes.name: Return Cited Answer
nodes.summary: Return the matched node, evidence class, citations, and related threads to the console; on missing Claude key respond 503 so the UI keeps the offline graph answering.

nodes.name: Check Voice Health
nodes.summary: Report whether local Whisper (STT) and Piper (TTS) are available so the HUD can choose local voice or Web Speech fallback.

nodes.name: Transcribe Audio (STT)
nodes.summary: Transcribe uploaded audio via the local Whisper model, returning 503 when Whisper is unavailable.

nodes.name: Synthesize Speech (TTS)
nodes.summary: Synthesize speech from text via local Piper, returning 503 when Piper or the voice model is not configured (Web Speech fallback).

edges.description: The analysis pipeline emits a GoldDecisionPacket that the paper-trading runtime wraps (never mutates) and evaluates for admission.
The guardrail engine produces a GuardResult that is forwarded into the execution gate (GATE-001); execution never recomputes it.
Runtime and execution outcomes feed the performance scorecard the Supervisor Office scores upgrade decisions against.
The JARVIS HUD and graph bridge visualize and answer questions about the trading pipeline's modules and stages via the engineering dev_graph.
